Messages.Author: Christoph Scherer
Messages.Body:
Last night, the question occurred to us whether a vampire (opposing Basilia
in this case) that has just played a Skin of Night is still a target for
Rötschreck... although we quickly ruled "yes" to keep up the game speed, we
were not so sure about that one.

Any comments please?
cs

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct. Rötschreck keys off of the attempt to use aggravated
damage against the opposing vampire; it doesn't care if the
damage will ultimately be prevented, transmuted, ignored, etc.
